tiers.name: Naive Per-Tensor FP8 FlashAttention (Sink Token 0 Stretches Global Scale)
tiers.note: Attention Sink (Token 0) has 30x higher magnitude, stretching the per-tensor scale and crushing 99.9% of tokens -> 0.0480 RMSE (-11.2 pt accuracy crash)!

tiers.name: Per-Head FP8 Scaling (Still Crushed by Fixed-Channel RoPE Outliers)
tiers.note: Separates heads, but within each head Token 0 and fixed outlier channels still dominate the 3-bit E4M3 mantissa (-4.8 pt drop).

tiers.name: FA3 Per-Block (64x128 Tile) FP8 Quantization (Isolates Sink Block 0)
tiers.note: Gives Block 0 (containing Token 0 sink) its own scale factor so Blocks 1..N retain full dynamic range, but channel-wise outliers remain.

tiers.name: FA3 Per-Block FP8 + Incoherent Hadamard Rotation (QH)(KH)^T = QK^T + FP32 Softmax
tiers.note: Applies orthogonal Hadamard rotation (QH)(KH)^T = QK^T to smear channel outliers + per-block tile scaling -> 16.0x lower RMSE (0.0030) & 1,180 TFLOPS!
